en.flavor: A caduceus symbolizing the glory of alchemy, made from special alloys to match its special status. It is exceedingly rigid and heavy, and would probably hurt pretty bad if used as a cudgel.

refinements.1: When the wielder performs healing, restore <r>8</r> Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s and can occur even when the character is not on the field.

refinements.5: When the wielder performs healing, restore <r>16</r> Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s and can occur even when the character is not on the field.

fr.flavor: Un caducée symbolisant la gloire de l'alchimie, fabriqué à partir d'alliages spéciaux qui correspondent à son statut particulier. Il est extrêmement rigide et lourd, et ferait probablement très mal s'il était utilisé comme un gourdin.
